text:
oscar: Quick follow-up from the recurrence scan I ran this morning. Main recurring signals over the last 6 months: KV "cold storms" during chained model swaps, noisy autoscaler downsizes right after bursts, and transient cross-region packet retransmits. Posting counts + short plan.

mei: Thanks. What time window and counts did you use?

oscar: Window = 2025-10-01..2026-03-31. Counts: kv_storms=17, autoscale_downs=12, region_retrans=8. Query snippet:```sql
SELECT root_cause, count(*) FROM incidents WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY root_cause ORDER BY count DESC;
```

dev: KV storms - are they correlated with specific model families or swap patterns?

oscar: Mostly large-context families and sessions that do rapid in-session swaps (swap-count >2 within 60s). Also a few cases after weight-rollout promos to Dedicated.

infra-bot: infra-bot created ticket INF-7210 for "KV swap cold-starts: counters + adaptive warmup"

claire: Proposed owners: mei -> KV counters + lightweight warmup (PoC 10d), dev -> autoscaler smoothing + canary (RFC 7d), ben -> cross-region retry heuristics + observability (10bd). Sound right?

mei: I can take KV counters. Plan: add per-model_version+deployment counter metrics.kv.cold_starts.v1 (TTL 90d) and kv.swap_heartbeat. PoC warmup: sampled prefix replays that heat top-K models. PoC in 10 days, mitigation + smoke test in 21 days. Note: will gate warmup with a per-deployment budget to avoid extra load.

dev: Autoscaler plan: introduce a short smoothing window (30s) and cap scale-down velocity (no more than 20%/min). Also add a "swap_protect" flag that prevents aggressive downscales for 60s after a detected model-swap event. I'll draft RFC and run perf-harness replays. Target RFC in 7 business days and a small canary thereafter.

ben: For cross-region retransmits: add jittered backoff, per-route circuit breakers, and a short sticky routing period (30s) to avoid immediate region failover. Add metrics: swap.tail95 and route.retry_rate. Canary plan: 5% regions -> 25%. Target initial canary in 10 business days.

claire: I'll own consolidated runbook updates and customer comms templates for Dedicated tenants. Draft comms in 4bd; will coordinate with CS/legal as needed.

oscar: Action recap: INF-7210 mei (KV counters + warmup, 10d PoC), INF-7211 dev (autoscaler RFC + canary, 7bd), INF-7212 ben (region retry heuristics + obs, 10bd). I'll schedule a checkpoint in two weeks here.

mei: Small implementation note: shard per-model counters and persist only top-N models by swap-volume to avoid high cardinality. Add sampling for others. I'll include details in INF-7210.

dev: Also adding a rollback rule in the RFC: immediate rollback if swap.tail95 > 2s for 2 consecutive 1-minute windows OR kv.hit_ratio < 0.45 for >60s.

infra-bot: reminder-bot scheduled follow-up in #incidents in 14 days for thread 2187654321

oscar: Thanks all. Please update the linked tickets with PRs, test links, and perf replay IDs. We'll validate success by targeting >=50% recurrence reduction over 30 days post-mitigation. Closing until the checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
